---
title: "About this platform"
---

Malaria Country Profiles is built by the MAP Data Engineering Team (DET)
to give malaria modelers a fast, standardized starting point before they
build a model for a given country.

Every profile — regardless of which country team wrote it — follows the
same source-backed template: 11 sections covering administrative
boundaries, the malaria situation, history, indicator summaries, the
health system, stratification/SNT, environment, vector profile, and
references. That consistency is the point: you can move from one
country's profile to another and know exactly where to find what you
need.

## How profiles are built

Country teams complete a shared submission template — a filled-in
content file plus an epi table and supporting exports — and hand it to
DET, who format it into the page you're reading.

See [Data Sources](data-sources.qmd) for what feeds the template itself,
or [Help](help.qmd) if you're submitting a profile and have a question.
